title: Sign NEAR Intents
description: Signs a NEAR Intents payload with this DAO's account on the Verifier (the MPC key on path agent-owner). Prepare both fields with `extents-e2e dao prepare`, and check the filed proposal with `extents-e2e dao verify <id>` before voting.

fields.name: intent
fields.label: Intent payload
fields.help: The NEP-413 payload to sign, as JSON: {"message", "nonce", "recipient"}. Voters can read it here; the hash below must be its NEP-413 hash.

fields.name: hash
fields.label: NEP-413 hash
fields.help: The payload's NEP-413 hash, in hex.
